notes: Official code loads images/ resized to width 1600 (-r -1), llffhold 8 -> mipnerf360-1600. Each scene needs its own method name (official hyper-parameters are selected by scene name): mesongs-<scene> = released scripts/mesongs_block.sh (config3, 8000 FT iterations). --steps must equal 38000 (30000 3DGS + 8000 FT; density raises otherwise; noft variants 30000). Compression stage at step 30000: importance over all train views, octree, RAHT tables, 1000-step VQ (minutes). ss-eval measures the decoded bitstream. Size: tools/ssenv python reproductions/mesongs/plugin/report_size.py <run> -> <run>/mesongs_size.json (zip_bytes = repo csv 'Size [Bytes]'; never checkpoint_bytes). Targets (official repo results/MipNeRF360 c3 csv, decoded): garden 26.39 dB / 42.94 MB(1e6) / 3.10M G, bicycle 24.54 / 42.00 / 3.16M, counter 28.59 / 12.60 / 0.88M; c1: 26.39 / 24.56 / 28.55.
